services_heading: Complete Electrical & AV Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: Whether you need a single socket replaced or a whole-house rewire, Blake's handles domestic and light commercial work with full certification and transparency.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Complete rewires to modern building standards with full Part P certification. We test every circuit and provide an EICR certificate on completion.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping electrics, dead sockets, or flickering lights? We diagnose the root cause and fix it quickly, often same day.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old fuse boxes with modern, safer consumer units. Includes full testing and a 10-year guarantee on parts.

services.title: Multi-Room AV Installation
services.desc: Bespoke home cinema and audio systems wired in-wall. Invisible runs, hidden wiring, and expert configuration to your taste.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, switches, and USB outlets added anywhere in your home. Clean runs, neat plastering, and tested to current regulations.

services.title: Electric Heating & Hot Water
services.desc: Immersion heater installation, storage heater wiring, and underfloor heating setup. Fully certified and energy-efficient.

about_pullquote: We do it right the first time, so you never worry about your safety.
about_para_1: Blake's AV & Electrical started in Southampton with a simple mission: provide honest, expert electrical work at fair prices. With over 15 years' experience and Part P certification, we've earned the trust of hundreds of Southampton homeowners and small businesses. Every job is completed to current Building Regulations, with full testing and certification included.
about_para_2: We specialise in the jobs other electricians find tedious — full rewires, AV system integration, and complex fault finding. Our customers return because we answer the phone, turn up on time, and explain what we're doing every step of the way. No cowboys, no surprise bills, no jargon.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Blake came out to sort a tricky rewire in our Edwardian terrace. Really knowledgeable bloke — explained everything as he went, didn't just rush through. Certificate arrived within days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called about a dodgy electrics issue on a Sunday evening. Blake fitted me in first thing Monday, found the fault straightaway, and had it sorted before lunch. Professional, fair price, and zero stress. Top lad.
reviews.author: Gemma H.

reviews.text: Had Blake install a multi-room AV system for us. The wiring is completely hidden, sound quality is brilliant, and he cleaned up after himself which is rare. Worth every penny. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: David K.
